subtasks: Wait for the opponent to discard a tile, then declare a kong with the matching tiles.
Push down only the three standing blue-symbol tiles matching the opponent's discard, fourth through sixth from the left, so their faces point upward. Keep every other tile upright.
Tip the remaining upright middle winter snowflake tile face-up. It is the tile between the two exposed snowflake tiles. Leave the other tiles undisturbed.

Draw the replacement tile from the top of the near end of the short wall on the left. Stand it upright flush against the far right end of your row, with its face and top matching the standing neighbors. Leave both grippers open.
